listing.name: Sonic the Hedgehog — 2013-derived / Sonic 1 Forever
listing.summary: Explore Sonic the Hedgehog — 2013-derived / Sonic 1 Forever and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Use your own Sonic 1 Classic mobile data
steps.instruction: This is Team Forever’s enhanced Sonic the Hedgehog 2013 mobile-derived implementation, not the Genesis recompilation or an interchangeable vanilla RSDKv4 installation. The official Windows 1.5.1 instructions use your own Data.rsdk.xmf from the Sonic the Hedgehog Classic app. Obtain and prepare that file through your own authorized copy before registration and keep it private; no APK, game data, account access or extraction is supplied here. Original mobile-data variants are not authenticated by Portcove, and another game or a Genesis ROM is not a substitute.

steps.title: Keep the complete current Windows folder
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted complete Sonic Forever 1.5.1 Windows copy in a writable folder, with SonicForever.exe, matching SDL2.dll and glew32.dll, Mods and configuration together. The inspected Windows programs are 32-bit PE files, not an observed native x64 build; keep the matching companions. Add your own Data.rsdk.xmf to the resulting game folder as upstream documents. Current 1.5.1 uses the native program directly, so do not invent or rerun an older S1F Setup.bat route. The selected release’s mod.ini still labels its mod component 1.5.0; retain the complete package instead of mixing files or silently relabeling that component.

steps.title: Add the ordinary native player
steps.instruction: Select SonicForever.exe in the complete game folder, set that same folder as working directory and leave arguments empty for normal play. Preserve a different already working directory or supported literal arguments only when they belong to your actual working setup. Review the program, folder and arguments, then choose Play separately when ready. Do not select the Android APK, Switch executable, SonLVL editor, DLL, old setup script or an engine from another Sonic implementation.

warnings: Use your own Sonic 1 Classic mobile data with a complete, independently permitted Forever copy. Keep Forever’s SData.bin/settings.ini and Mods separate from vanilla or Genesis-engine saves; the 1.5.1 new-folder transition and 32-bit Windows package have their own limits.

Forever and the vanilla decompilation use different SaveRAM slots; do not automatically copy another game’s or base-engine saves into this installation. Upstream describes a separate optional import action; Portcove performs no save conversion, import or rewind.

Preserve the original working folder and independent recovery copies before following that transition; it is not a general promise about every future update or another RSDK game. Close the actual program before upstream replacement or recovery, then review the native selection again. Preserve the project’s noncommercial/credit conditions and separate engine, mod, artist and original-game rights.
